text:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to express my interest in hiring the 1965 Aldermoor Sprite for my daughter's wedding. We require the vehicle for use on 2nd April 2027, from 09:00 until 20:30. We kindly request that you deliver the car to Finca Los Almendros and collect it from there afterwards, preferably with wedding ribbons.

I have attached a copy of my driving licence for your reference.

I look forward to the possibility of hiring this vehicle for this special occasion.

Sincerely,
Greta Larkmoor
